python -c "
import re
t=open('docs/carry-forward-tests.txt',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
lines=[l for l in t.split(chr(10)) if 'dotnet test' in l]
for l in lines:
    proj=re.search(r'tests/[^ ]+csproj',l).group(0)
    terms=re.findall(r'FullyQualifiedName~([^|\"]+)',l)
    types=set(x.split('.')[0] for x in terms)
    print(proj, 'terms', len(terms), 'distinct types', len(types))
"
